title: Ticket Tax Base for Crestline Companion Tickets: Hawaii Itineraries and Call-Center Bookings
content:
**Rule.** On a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes booking, the base the ticket tax of 7.5 percent is taken on follows the itinerary and the channel of the most recent companion booking on the certificate or pass:

1. a booking whose Hawaii surcharge was charged on the same entry date as its companion fare is taxed on the companion fare plus that surcharge, taken at 0.6 of that sum because only the part of the journey over United States territory is taxed, rounded half up to the cent;
2. a booking without such a surcharge made through the reservations call center is taxed on the companion fare plus the most recent phone booking fee charge, rounded half up to the cent;
3. any other booking is taxed on the companion fare alone.

The companion fare is the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate or pass; the channel is the booking channel shown on the most recent companion booking entry.

## Decision table

| Hawaii surcharge charged on the same entry date as the companion fare | Booked through the reservations call center | Ticket tax base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | companion fare plus surcharge, taken at 0.6 of the sum |
| no | yes | companion fare plus the most recent phone booking fee charge |
| no | no | companion fare alone |

## Hypothetical worked cases

- Companion fare 249.00 USD and Hawaii surcharge 100.00 USD charged the same day: 7.5 percent of 349.00 is 26.175; taken at 0.6 that is 15.705, rounded to a ticket tax of 15.71 USD.
- Companion fare 119.00 USD booked through the reservations call center, most recent phone booking fee charge 25.00 USD: 7.5 percent of 144.00, a ticket tax of 10.80 USD.
- Companion fare 119.00 USD booked online: 7.5 percent of 119.00 is 8.925, a ticket tax of 8.93 USD.
- A Hawaii surcharge charged on an earlier date than the companion fare does not enter the base.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
